fields.matured_on: policy admin — not on the portfolio sheet
fields.maturity_date: the intelligence sheet or policy admin — not on the portfolio sheet
fields.token: the send list — opaque, never a policy number
fields.segment: the send list — the letter's own key

taps.urgent: I want an agent now. Let me tell you my concerns first
taps.review: Tell me what I hold, in writing
taps.pay: Set me up to pay Guardian Life directly
taps.question: My details have changed

letters.name: A policy has matured
letters.subject: A policy of yours has matured. The money is waiting.
letters.preheader: It reached the end of its term. The money is yours, and it is waiting to be claimed.
letters.send_note: Only a handful of this group have e-mail. The rest is a phone call, and it is the one call nobody resents.

letters.name: A maturity coming up
letters.subject: A policy of yours matures on {{maturity_date}}
letters.preheader: We would like the money to reach you on time, and to talk through what comes next before it does.
letters.send_note: Six months ahead of the date. The maturity date is not on the portfolio sheet; it comes from the intelligence sheet or policy admin.

letters.name: Paid up
letters.subject: You have finished paying for this one
letters.preheader: Nothing more to pay. Here is what you own outright.
letters.send_note: Nearly all of this group have e-mail.

letters.name: Carrying waiver of premium
letters.subject: A benefit inside your policy you may not know about
letters.preheader: If illness stopped you working, Guardian Life would pay your premiums for you.
letters.send_note: The strongest letter in the set. Send it second, after A and B have warmed the domain.

letters.name: Collected off a payroll
letters.subject: We are checking your salary deduction, so you need not
letters.preheader: Deductions sometimes stop quietly. We are checking yours this week.
letters.send_note: The word "arrears" does not appear. Until the deduction file is reconciled, a gap is ours to chase.

letters.name: Held ten years or more
letters.subject: {{years}} years at a price nobody can sell you again
letters.preheader: Your premium is fixed on the age you were when you started. That price cannot be bought twice.
letters.send_note: Only a third of this group have e-mail. The rest is a phone call; the argument is strongest here.

letters.name: In force
letters.subject: Your policy is unchanged. One tap tells us what you would like next.
letters.preheader: Same cover, same premium, same beneficiaries. Then whichever answer suits you.
letters.send_note: The core letter. The largest group and the best reach.

letters.name: Lapsed
letters.subject: A policy you may have written off could still be worth something
letters.preheader: A policy that stopped does not always stop being worth something.
letters.send_note: A week behind the others. It does not mention the departure at all.

letters.name: Nothing held
letters.subject: Is this still the right address for you?
letters.preheader: A short note from the branch that looked after you.

letters.name: One premium showing as due
letters.subject: One premium is showing as due. One tap puts it right.
letters.preheader: Already paid it? Tell us and we put the record right. Not yet? Nothing is lost.
letters.send_note: Sixty-one to ninety days on the Days column, after the paid-to date is checked against cash and the deduction file.

letters.name: More than one premium showing as due
letters.subject: Your policy is still in force. Let us keep it that way.
letters.preheader: The value it has built may be carrying it for now. Here is what the law says, and three ways to answer.
letters.send_note: Ninety-one to one hundred and eighty days on the Days column. The paid-to date checked first.

letters.name: A decision the policy needs
letters.subject: Your policy needs a decision, and the law gives you time
letters.preheader: Nothing can be forfeited without written notice and twenty business days. Here is what to do with them.
letters.send_note: Over one hundred and eighty days on the Days column. Checked against cash first. The receiving agent calls within two days.

letters.name: Contract ready, not yet delivered
letters.subject: Your contract is ready. We will bring it to you.
letters.preheader: Your policy is in force. The document itself has not reached you yet.
letters.send_note: From the contracts-given-to-agent list. Delivered within the week by the receiving agent.

letters.name: An application still in progress
letters.subject: Your application: where it stands, and who is finishing it
letters.preheader: It has not been forgotten. Whatever is still needed, we bring to you.
letters.send_note: From the pending list. Every file is read before the call.
